finalText:
**Renamed `calcTotal` to `computeTotal` everywhere.**

Changed the function and export in `src/cart.js`, plus the imports and calls in `index.js`, `invoice.js`, and `report.js`. The comment in `cart.js` now names the new function too.

All 4 tests pass in 66ms. Run them with `node --test tests/total.test.js`, since `node --test tests/` fails on Windows.

The one leftover `calcTotal` is in the test at `tests/total.test.js:18`, which checks the old name is gone. That is meant to be there.
